text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-cha~n! Wanna play together?
I brought an awesome game with me~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's the super latest competitive action game!
Ah, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Let's race!!
Not that there's any doubt Turbo will win, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's everyone's first time playing this game, so please feel free to join in, Trainer-san♪

One day in the early afternoon.
While clearing through a mountain of work,
Transcend and the others showed up.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, look at all these documents, whoa!
Could it be that you're super busy?
choice_data_list: Yeah... Actually, yeah. But maybe a change of pace would help.

text_block_list.text:
Since I was at a dead end myself,
I was genuinely grateful for Transcend's invitation.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"'K. Then right away,
I'll be takin' Trai-chan's lifelog, 'kay?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. In this game, the player's life log gets reflected
in their character's stats to fight.
Heart rate, autonomic nervous balance, sleep duration, and all that.

"Using a wristband-type tracking device and
manually entered figures, a life log is recorded
within the game."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Btw, it's a battle royale, so the last player standing wins.
Simple, right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's see how Trainy's stats look... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Nope. Alright, let's get started!

The avatar descends onto the wasteland field.
With barely a moment to check the controls,
a fierce battle began—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
First, a blow by way of greeting!
Trainer! Take my fist!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Teio's getting a head start!
Wait, wait, wait, waaaait!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, forgive me.
Your back was completely defenseless, you see♪
choice_data_list: From every direction!? Why is it always me!?
From every direction!? Why is it always me!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, Trainie's already in trouble!
Your stats are way too low, that unhealthy lifestyle came back to bite ya!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No choice, then. Okay, leave it to me!
—Aaaand hup!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (I'll guard Trainy with a ranged attack! Then, relieved, Trainy should finally unleash a skill right here—)

However, the attack dealt no damage.
And Tokai Teio and the others weren't about
to let that opening go to waste—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now's the time!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And the plan is for me to cover that part!

Transcend timed the exact moment everyone jumped in
and unleashed her move—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look out!
Gathering energy for a big move, huh... Not bad!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, that's unfair!
Why are you two colluding over there, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It'd be super sad if only you had to leave early,
Trainer-chan, right~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! Until I beat Teio,
Turbo is... NOT going down hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo Knuckle! Turbo Kick!
Turbo Ignition RUUUUSH!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We can't just stay on the defensive!
Trainy! It's time we make our move!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Such a monotonous offense...
Heh, I'll just slowly corner you like this—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Off the wall—combo strike!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Guard!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: She read me like a book...!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"When you're playing against Loves-chan,
you've gotta watch out for the corner of the screen."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh!! Whatever it is, just shave away at it non-stooop!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone's gathered in one spot!
You won't get away—!
choice_data_list: Oh no, they're right behind us!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Take this, everrryone all together!
Wagahai Impactââ!!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! A total sweep for Teio-chan, huh!
And I was so close, too~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tran's "Gather and Ultimate Move"!
Seeing that gave me the idea!
I really am the strongest, aren't I~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No wayyy!
Teio! One more time!
Let's go one more timeee!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Even so... Tran-san and her Trainer showed some incredible teamwork, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah.
Nice combination♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, somehow...
rather than a Trainer and their Umamusume, you two seem more like lifelong friends♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Re-checking Trainer-chan's stats!
Vibe is good, smile is good, and complexion is... all good!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Mm. Looks like you played to your heart's content.
All's well that ends well~.
choice_data_list: Playing with all our might felt so refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi. You were getting into crisis after crisis
and screaming your head off, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I got pretty fired up myself.
Down-to-the-wire showdowns really are thrilling and the absolute best, ya know♪"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh. ...Ayyy, looks like
I did another great job~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, when it comes to backing up Trainie,
you can leave it all to Tran-chan♪
